changeSet.author: Salim Kham
changeSet.sql: UPDATE hr_monthly_data hrd SET hrd.source_type = CASE WHEN hrd.hr_variable LIKE '%EXP_%' OR hrd.hr_variable LIKE '%EXPENSE%' THEN 'EXPENSE' WHEN hrd.hr_variable LIKE '%BNS_%' OR hrd.hr_variable LIKE '%BONUS%'THEN 'SALARY_BONUS' WHEN hrd.hr_variable LIKE '%ADVS%' OR hrd.hr_variable LIKE '%ADVANCE%' THEN 'SALARY_ADVANCE' WHEN hrd.hr_variable = 'MEAL_VOUCHER' THEN 'MEAL_VOUCHER' WHEN hrd.hr_variable = 'RESOURCE_MUTUAL' THEN 'RESOURCE_MUTUAL' WHEN hrd.hr_variable = 'TEMPLATE' THEN 'TEMPLATE' WHEN hrd.hr_variable LIKE '%ABS%' OR hrd.hr_variable LIKE '%ABSENCE%'THEN 'ABSENCE' WHEN hrd.hr_variable LIKE '%DAYS_NBR_RCT%' OR hrd.hr_variable LIKE '%CONTRACT_OFF_DAYS%' THEN 'CONTRACT' WHEN hrd.hr_variable LIKE '%EXTRA_HOURS%' THEN 'EXTRA_HOURS' ELSE 'NOT_FOUND' END;
